description: Spring Boot starts a Spring application with ready-made defaults. These lessons build tiny HTTP endpoints without a database. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Install Java 17 or later and JBang. Save one example as Lesson.java and run jbang Lesson.java. JBang downloads the dependency on the //DEPS line. Use http://127.0.0.1:8080 and stop the server before another example.
versionNote: Examples use Spring Boot 3.3.5, Java 17 or later, and JBang.
whatYouWillLearn: Return a greeting with Spring Boot
Use a query default with Spring Boot
Reject a missing title with Spring Boot
Set reply metadata with Spring Boot
learningObjectives: Return a greeting with Spring Boot
Parse a whole number with Spring Boot
Return several records with Spring Boot
